question: Should OpenClaw expose a plugin-visible skill install/update completion observer, and what redacted payload plus observer-failure semantics should it use?
rationale: Source inspection proves the remaining hook surface is missing, but choosing install metadata exposure and whether observer failures can affect an already-written install is a security and product API decision.

options.title: Add Minimal Observer
options.body: Add a non-blocking completion hook with redacted source, target, provenance, outcome, and timestamp metadata, and fail-open logging semantics.

options.title: Keep Pre-Install Only
options.body: Declare `security.installPolicy` and `before_install` sufficient, then close or narrow the audit-observer portion as intentionally out of scope.

options.title: Defer To ClawHub Trust Design
options.body: Hold the observer until a broader ClawHub trust, provenance, and publish/install policy design owns the event model.

recommendation.title: Add Minimal Observer
recommendation.body: Add a non-blocking completion hook with redacted source, target, provenance, outcome, and timestamp metadata, and fail-open logging semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved question is primarily product/security API scope, and this owner appears in the issue routing context for deciding whether the remaining observer belongs in core.
